additional_info.body:
Hi Luca,
Thanks for your confirmation.
To reconfigure the XF4, kindly go to SCB and follow the steps below:
Router Configuration
Select the router (XF4)
Auth. Mode > None
Enter the APN of the M2M SIM card as per the network provider.
Save these config.
Thank you.
